Brazilian Rice
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:02am

Ingredients




1 cup uncooked rice
1 package Frozen spinach
3 Eggs
1 cup Milk
1 tablespoon Grated onion
1/2 teaspoon Thyme
1/2 teaspoon Marjoram
1/2 teaspoon Rosemary
1 cup American cheese, grated

Preparation

1 Cook the rice according to package directions.  2 Beat the eggs and mix with milk.  3 Combine all ingredients and place in a buttered casserole dish. Dot with butter and bake in a 300 degree F oven until set, about 40 minutes.

About


Rice is a traditional side dish in Brazil. This may or may not be authentic, but it is delicious!
